environment.import_method: documentation and source reading (wiki USTX page; Formats/USTx.cs and OpenUtau.Core.csproj in the repository, master as read)

input.description: What the file contains vs what OpenUtau promises is stable

expected.summary: A readable YAML file is not a stability promise.

observed.summary: The USTX wiki page documents fields and recommends YAML 1.2 handling (ruamel.yaml over PyYAML). The loader in the repository source sets kUstxVersion, upgrades projects with a lower ustx_version and throws 'Project file is newer than software' for a higher one. No document promises compatibility between releases.

classification_note: UNKNOWN as to any stability promise: none was found. The wiki documents the format but states no compatibility guarantee. Evidence of drift: wiki 0.6, release 0.1.565 saves 0.7, master source is 0.10. Evidence of handling: the loader upgrades older versions and refuses a file newer than the software. Not a promise, so the format is not treated as stable.

details.implication: a generated project should target the lowest ustx_version that carries what is needed and be verified against each supported OpenUtau version
